MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and climatic conditions in marine and Freshwater and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
